shared_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE transparent game UI module emblem for GRIDSHARD, intended to remain readable at 32px. References are STYLE ONLY: match their chunky stylized casual/RPG game illustration, broad crisp chamfers, saturated enamel-like planes, dark indigo contour, modest upper-left highlight and clearly shaded lower-right side. This is a volumetric illustrated emblem, not a realistic machine or metallic product render. Center one object within a square canvas with 12 percent transparent padding on every side, bold simple silhouette, front view with slight visible depth, at most three large internal shapes. Preserve the subject's semantic identity exactly. No background plate, badge disc, tile, ground, drop shadow outside the object, text, number, border frame, particles, rays, fog, watermark, microdetails, photoreal chrome or white sparkle bloom. Actual transparent background. Use the assigned class color as the main body; navy outline and small ice/light highlight, restrained gold only for functional terminals or tiny center. Deliver only ONE object, not a sheet or variants.

items.subject: A single angular lightning bolt, long crisp zig-zag, thick carved coral-red body with a clear side plane. No gun body, no pedestal.
A pointed kite shield, blue enamel body, dark navy edge, one small ice-blue faceted diamond inset in its center. No sword or surrounding frame.
A chunky six-arm snowflake with broad angular solid branches, one small faceted center, mint-green main body and icy highlights. No ice cube behind it.
One upright compact battery, broad turquoise body, one squat dark terminal at top, one large gold lightning inset. Simple crisp rectangular silhouette with chamfered corners.
One very thick equal-arm plus sign, chunky leaf-green block, consistent arm widths, broad front planes and darker visible side. Clearly a PLUS, no medical bag or other object.

A bold purple prohibition symbol: thick freestanding circular ring with one diagonal slash across its empty center. Volumetric ring and slash, actual transparent hole, no backing disc, no lightning bolt.

A single thick crescent moon facing right, sharp upper and lower tips, broad mint-green face and darker green side plane, empty transparent concavity. Repair identity is crescent, NOT a plus, wrench or medical cross.
A single broad slanted armor plate, chamfered parallelogram silhouette, blue front face and darker thick bottom edge, only four large pale rivets, no shield outline or emblem inside.

A single front-facing pulse cannon muzzle: thick coral outer torus, dark open navy bore and a small gold energy center, very short visible side barrel gives depth. No stand, no military-realistic parts, no firing ray.
One upright compact stylized rocket, coral body, pale pointed nose, two broad coral tail fins, one dark circular porthole and a short gold exhaust tip, no flame trail, no launcher rack or base.
